name: @red-cup-engineering/eavt
description: Plain EAVT: strict {e,a,v,t} row identity, durable append, torn-line-tolerant disk read-back, the per-predicate functional read-lens (supersede), the general relational graph read (relate/relateFrom), fold with retraction tombstones, settle, settled-section projection, entity constitution (constituteEntity/entityAddress — the <kind>:<ni-digest> address rule), the braided-tower stratification (saturate/transfer/stratify — Level 0 asserted, Level 1 saturated = Fix σ, Level 2 settled = Fix σ ∩ Fix Δ, as two separate derived passes, never one lumped fold), and proof-tree citation resolution (citationsOf/resolveProofTree/verifyProofClosure — a claim as a Merkle DAG of ni:/entity-address/metroplat-artifact references, resolved as a flat {root, nodes} map per the proof-DAG note, never inlined). SEAVT (EAVT where each e,a,v is meant to be RMN) is a distinct, downstream lineage in witness-journal/semiotic custody, not this package.
